ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)
test_cases_present: partial — the TFP410 datasheet defines explicit DC + AC electrical characteristics, input setup/hold timing, output rise/fall + skew + jitter, plus I2C register-access behaviour. These map directly to compliance test categories but the datasheet itself is not a self-contained testbench. The DVI Compliance Test Specification and HDMI Compliance Test Specification (CTS) provide the formal test programmes.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Pixel-rate sweep: f_IDCK from 25 MHz to 165 MHz; verify PLL locks at every rate, TMDS output valid, receiver locks.
Single-edge 24-bit mode (BSEL=1): drive DATA[23:0] + DE + sync at all rates; verify per-channel pixel mapping (TX0=B, TX1=G, TX2=R).
Dual-edge 12-bit mode (BSEL=0): drive DATA[11:0] + DE + sync on both IDCK+ edges; verify Tables 6-2 / 6-3 mapping reconstructs full 24-bit pixel.
High-swing input (V_REF=DV_DD): V_IH ≥ 0.7×DV_DD, V_IL ≤ 0.3×DV_DD; full functional sweep.
Low-swing input (V_REF=0.55..0.9V): V_IH ≥ V_REF+0.2, V_IL ≤ V_REF-0.2; sweep at low/mid/high V_REF.
Differential clock mode (low-swing only): drive IDCK± differentially; verify crossover-point timing reference works.
Single-ended clock mode: drive IDCK+ only, IDCK- tied LOW; verify rising-or-falling-edge latching per EDGE.
EDGE=0 (falling-edge latch): verify t_su(IDF) ≥ 1.2 ns, t_h(IDF) ≥ 1.3 ns at 165 MHz.
EDGE=1 (rising-edge latch): verify t_su(IDR) ≥ 1.2 ns, t_h(IDR) ≥ 1.3 ns at 165 MHz.
Dual-edge timing: verify t_su(ID) ≥ 0.9 ns, t_h(ID) ≥ 1.0 ns at both edges.
T.M.D.S. encoder coverage: 256 input bytes × 3 channels; verify 8 → 10 bit transition-minimised + DC-balance produces the canonical TMDS character per running disparity state.
Running disparity tracking: feed long sequence of same-byte; verify disparity converges and inversion alternates correctly.
Control character generation: DE=low; sweep {VSYNC,HSYNC} ∈ {00,01,10,11}; verify TX0 emits 0x354 / 0x0AB / 0x154 / 0x2AB respectively.
CTL[3]=0 invariant: verify TX2 control characters always reflect CTL[3]=0 (HDCP reserved).
DE transition coverage: verify clean encoding at DE 0→1 and 1→0 boundaries.
Video preamble + guard band (HDMI-only): document as NOT EMITTED by TFP410 — system-level test for full HDMI receiver compatibility relies on external preamble/guard-band insertion.
PLL lock time: time from PD=1 to TMDS output valid; verify ≤ specified PLL lock time at min/typ/max f_IDCK.
Output swing V_SWING: verify 400-600 mV single-ended with R_TFADJ ≈ 510 Ω across PVT.
Output rise/fall t_r / t_f: verify 75-240 ps at 165 MHz (20-80% levels).
Intra-pair skew t_sk(D): verify ≤ 50 ps at 165 MHz on each TX0/TX1/TX2/TXC pair.
Inter-pair (channel-to-channel) skew t_sk(CC): verify ≤ 1.2 ns at 165 MHz across all 4 pairs.
Output clock jitter t_ojit: verify ≤ 150 ps relative to IDCK at 165 MHz.
De-skew sweep: DK[3:1] = 000..111 (8 codes); verify t_CD = (DK-4) × t_STEP latching shift; confirm t_STEP ≈ 350 ps.
I2C target tests: write/read VEN_ID (=0x014C), DEV_ID (=0x0410), REV_ID. Verify R-only / RW field behavior of CTL_1_MODE / CTL_2_MODE / CTL_3_MODE.
I2C address strap: verify A[3:1] (pins 6/7/8) selects base address 0x70..0x7E correctly for write and 0x71..0x7F for read.
I2C reset: pulse ISEL/RST low then high; verify all registers return to defaults (PD=0 → device powered down).
Power-up / power-down toggle: cycle PD via I2C; verify TMDS output goes to V_OFF then re-enables after PLL re-lock.
TDIS toggle: set CTL_1_MODE.TDIS=1; verify TMDS disabled but PLL still running.
VEN / HEN toggle: set VEN=0 / HEN=0; verify VSYNC / HSYNC transmitted as fixed LOW in control characters.
DE-generator mode: enable DE_CTL.DE_GEN=1 + program DE_DLY/DE_CNT/DE_TOP/DE_LIN; verify internal DE matches programmed window; external DE pin ignored.
H_RES / V_RES counter accuracy: drive known HSYNC/VSYNC; read H_RES, V_RES; verify counts match.
HTPLG sample: drive EDGE/HTPLG pin LOW then HIGH; verify CTL_2_MODE.HTPLG reads correctly; MDI fires per TSEL=1.
RSEN sense (DC-coupled receiver): connect a powered TMDS receiver; verify CTL_2_MODE.RSEN=1; disconnect, verify RSEN=0.
MSEN open-drain output: program MSEL[3:1] to drive MDI / RSEN / HTPLG; verify external pull-up sees correct level.
DDC EDID read (via I2C controller path): send Start → 0xA0 → sub-addr 0x00 → Restart → 0xA1 → read 128 bytes; verify EDID block returned.
ESD test: ±4 kV HBM on DVI pins; ±2 kV HBM on all other pins.
Power supply sweep: DV_DD/PV_DD/TV_DD = 3.0/3.3/3.6 V; verify functional across range.
Operating-temperature sweep: T_A = 0 °C / 25 °C / 70 °C; verify all timing parameters in spec.
